# ArtCraft Store

> Community-maintained catalog of extensions for PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft, and VectorCraft.

## API integration

- [Agent-friendly API v1 reference](https://akkk09.github.io/artcraft-store/api/v1/README.md): integration steps, catalog fields, download resolution, JavaScript methods, and security considerations.
- [API discovery manifest](https://akkk09.github.io/artcraft-store/api/v1/manifest.json): machine-readable API metadata and endpoint locations.
- [Catalog JSON](https://akkk09.github.io/artcraft-store/catalog.json): current catalog data; filter the `plugins` array client-side.
- [JavaScript client module](https://akkk09.github.io/artcraft-store/api/v1/client.js): dependency-free ES module for fetching and filtering the catalog and resolving download URLs.
- [Repository README](https://github.com/akkk09/artcraft-store#readme): project overview and contributor information.

## Important integration notes

- The API is static, public, read-only, and requires no API key.
- There is no server-side search or plugin lookup endpoint.
- Download URL resolution priority is `downloadUrl`, then `releaseAsset`, then `artifact`.
- Resolved URLs and catalog entries do not guarantee artifact availability, compatibility, integrity, or safety.
- Launchers must implement their own compatibility checks, safe download/install behavior, and user consent.
- Clients should ignore unknown fields and tolerate missing optional metadata.
